name: Marseille Soap
where: La Corvette or Fer à Cheval flagship stores
about: A traditional olive-oil-based soap made in Marseille for centuries. It is known for its simple, pure formula.
tip: Check that the label says 72% vegetable oils, and confirm the maker before you buy.

name: Santon Figurine
where: Santons Marcel Carbonel, Rue Neuve Sainte-Catherine
about: A small handmade clay figure from Provençal Christmas nativity scenes. Santons are a local craft tradition of Provence.
tip: Look for pieces that are handmade and hand-painted, not mass-produced.

name: Navette Biscuits
about: Boat-shaped cookies flavored with orange blossom. They are a famous old-fashioned sweet from Marseille bakeries.
tip: Buy them at this long-established bakery, which is a well-known local spot.
